readers.heading: No feed reader yet?
readers.intro: These four are free, open source and ad-free. Pick the one that suits you, then paste the address above into it:
readers.newsblur: if you read on several devices. It works in your browser and has iPhone and Android apps, kept in sync by a free account (up to 64 sites; more for $36 a year).
readers.netnewswire: if you use Apple devices. An app for Mac, iPhone and iPad with no account needed, kept in sync through iCloud.
readers.fluentreader: if you read on a Windows, Mac or Linux computer. A clean desktop app with no account needed.
readers.feeder: if you read on an Android phone. A simple app with no account needed.
